title: Memory Care Residency Agreement Admission Terms: Signing Authority, Tier Placement and Assessment Validity
content:
Admission under the Memory Care Residency Agreement runs from the signed admission agreement to the move into the secured memory care neighborhood, on the following terms.

## Terms

1. **Diagnosis, order and age.** Where the tier requires a physician's written diagnosis, admission requires a physician's written diagnosis of dementia or a related cognitive disorder and a physician's admission order dated no more than the tier's order validity period before move-in, and the resident must be at least the tier's minimum age on the planned move-in date.
2. **Who signs.** The admission agreement, any withdrawal and any notice must be signed by a representative whose authority on the resident's customer record is financial power of attorney, durable power of attorney or guardian, because a memory care resident is presumed unable to contract alone. The authority recorded on the customer record is what counts.
3. **Tier placement.** The care program is the one whose score band contains the pre-admission assessment score, and the tier is that program in the suite type the family chooses, subject to the maximum number of residents the suite holds.
4. **Assessment validity at move-in.** Move-in may take place only within the pre-admission assessment validity period after the pre-admission assessment, as recorded on the residency's assessment record. The validity period is counted in calendar days from the assessment date, the assessment date being day 0, and move-in on the last day is still valid. For every tier the period is 30 calendar days.
5. **Withdrawal.** Before move-in the representative may sign a withdrawal of the admission, which cancels the residency. Nothing is charged for a withdrawn admission, because the monthly rate and community fee begin at move-in.

## Signing authority at a glance

| Authority recorded for the representative | May sign the admission agreement, a withdrawal or a notice |
|---|---|
| Financial power of attorney | Yes |
| Durable power of attorney | Yes |
| Guardian | Yes |
| Any other authority, or none recorded | No |

The last row follows from the closed list in term 2.

## Assessment validity: worked boundary (hypothetical dates)

Pre-admission assessment completed on 10 March (day 0); validity period 30 calendar days.

| Proposed move-in date | Day count from the assessment | Move-in valid |
|---|---|---|
| 8 April | 29 | Yes |
| 9 April | 30 - the last day | Yes |
| 10 April | 31 | No |

## Tier placement: illustration (hypothetical score)

A pre-admission score that falls within the enhanced program's band places the resident in the enhanced program, whatever suite the family prefers; the tier is then the enhanced program in the suite type the family chooses among the suite types in which that program is offered, and a companion suite only within its limit on residents.

## Basis Q&A

**Does a withdrawn admission owe a prorated month or the community fee?** No. Both begin at move-in, and a withdrawn admission never reaches move-in.

**Whose age counts?** The resident's, measured on the planned move-in date.
